topic: Know your colour codes: asked what colour the logo is, most people have one word, like 'purple', and the signwriter, the printer and the web designer can each land on a different purple. A code takes the guessing out: a hex code on a website (a # and six characters), CMYK or a Pantone number in print. The NHS lists its blue as Pantone 300, hex #005EB8. Ask whoever made your logo for your codes and keep them handy.

topic: Broken links after a rebuild: a page that has moved leaves its old address leading to 'Page not found'. Google's help: if the content has moved, add a redirect from the old address to the page that replaced it; for a move that's for good Google recommends a permanent server-side redirect, the best way to get people and Google Search to the right page. Tonight, click every link on your homepage and send any 404 to whoever looks after the website.
